target.name: CG POWER AND IND SOL LTD

profile.mgmt: Amar Kaul (MD & CEO) · Susheel Todi (CFO) + segment VPs (transformers, switchgear, motors, railways, drives)
profile.subseg: **Power Systems** — power transformers, switchgear, **GIS**; **Industrial Systems** — motors, drives, railways; **Semiconductors** (CG Semi, investment phase); G.G. Tronics (railway signalling)

deepdive.sec: Power / Grid Equipment & Energy Transition (the **OEM / demand side**)

bull_bear.body:
- Industrial Systems margin (railways pricing, commodity); semiconductor cash drain until it scales.
- Receivables rising with power growth (90–100 day terms).
- Commodity inflation (motors/PVC); tariff impact in some export geographies (consciously slowed some).
- Execution/quality is the stated differentiator as capacity scales fast.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: - Confident, execution-focused ("Amrit Kaal"); aggressive but disciplined capacity build; candid on industrial margin drag and semiconductor investment. Strong ROCE (22% / power 100%+).
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- **CG is the demand keystone for the whole folder:** a transformer OEM scaling capacity 17k→110k MVA is exactly what drives the bushing (Yash), CTC/winding-wire (KSH/Apar/Bhagyanagar) and transformer-oil (Apar) shortages. Its +91% power backlog is the cleanest single proxy for the cycle's durability.
- CG is *also* a **RIP-bushing localizer** (named by Yash) — partial vertical integration into the scarce component.
- Power-side **ROCE >100%** + 22–24% margins = the most profitable expression of the cycle in the set; semiconductor is the wildcard.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body:
> CG is the **demand engine**: its capacity ramp *creates* the component shortages the suppliers below ride.

| Challenge (their words) | Beneficiary stock(s) — NSE · BSE · role | Loser | Why / conviction |
|---|---|---|---|
| Transformer capacity 17k→110k MVA pulls component shortage | Yash Highvoltage ✅ (YASHHV·544310 bushings); KSH ✅ (KSHINTL·544664 CTC); APAR ✅ (APARINDS·532259 oil); Bhagyanagar ✅ (BHAGYANGR·512296 busbars) | — | OEM ramp = the shortage cause — High |
| Industrial Systems margin pressure (railway pricing + motor PVC) | — | CG Power industrial seg (CGPOWER·500093) | commodity + competitive pricing drag — Low |
| Semiconductor (CG Semi) cash drain until scale | — | CG Power near-term (₹111cr FY26 drag) | long-dated optionality — Low |
| RIP-bushing localization (CG is a localizer) | CG Power (CGPOWER·500093); Yash ✅ (YASHHV·544310) | bushing importers | partial vertical integration into scarce component — Med |

latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log

outlook.body:
- **Power demand "huge all over the world"; domestic ex-large-orders growing ~15–20%** ("the game has just started"). Utilities/govt "give us more, give us more."
- **Transformer capacity:** Gwalior 6k→10k MVA; Bhopal/Mandideep →40k→**65k MVA** (lean); **Greenfield commissioning Jul–Aug 2026** (25–30k → 45k MVA by CY-end) → **~110,000 MVA total by end-CY26**, across all ratings to **765kV (new plant up to 1,200kV)**.
- **GIS:** 400kV commercialization in **FY27** (type-test Q2–Q3); 765kV "in conversation." GIS market ~₹12,000cr (24–30% GIS, rest AIS).
- **Motors:** double-digit (50/50 price/volume); IE3/IE4 adoption slow in India but expected to pick up. Drives: new AMX launches; LV drives ~100% indigenous.
- **Exports & services:** key focus; order bookings >doubled YoY.
outlook.title: Guidance / outlook

outlook.body:
- Standalone backlog **₹15,719cr (+59%)**, consol ₹17,107cr (+61%) → strong FY27 revenue visibility.
- **₹900cr hyperscaler data-centre transformer order** (12–20 month delivery, FAS Mumbai). Power-side credit ~90–100 days (drives receivables).
- G.G. Tronics (railway signalling): backlog ~₹1,000cr; passenger trials nearly done → execution starts ~1–1.5 months.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body:
- **Data centres:** hyperscaler transformer order (₹900cr) + pursuing US grid utilities.
- **GIS** (400→765kV), **HVDC-class transformers** (new plant to 1,200kV).
- **Semiconductors (CG Semi):** strategic long-dated build (drag now).
- Exports/services scale-up.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: The diversified transformer + switchgear **OEM** at the centre of the grid super-cycle — *"Amrit Kaal for the power sector."* Record FY26 (standalone +21% rev, PBT +39%); **Power Systems exploding** (FY rev +46%, order backlog **+91% YoY**, 22–24% PBIT margins). **Transformer capacity ramping 17k → 110k MVA** in ~2 yrs, up to 765kV (new plant to 1,200kV). It's the **demand engine** that pulls bushings, CTC/winding wire, transformer oil and switchgear components — i.e. the buyer behind the other names' shortages. Semiconductor build-out is the long-dated optionality (and a near-term drag).
